limits: Zero ablation may induce out-of-distribution states.

Non-additivity can arise from output softmax, loss curvature, LayerNorm, downstream computation or accuracy thresholds; it alone does not identify redundancy, backup behavior, mediation or a complete mechanism.
Fixed synthetic task and three existing checkpoints; no retraining or head alignment across seeds.
Balanced stratified sample; uncertainty conditions on fixed stratum counts.

uncertainty.degenerate_policy: CI may collapse; flag descriptive only, never declare resolved nonzero effect
uncertainty.family: 84 pair-by-metric interactions within each training seed; no joint claim across seeds
uncertainty.interpretation: Approximate conditional bootstrap uncertainty, not exact familywise coverage. Pointwise single/joint effect intervals are descriptive and unadjusted. No pooled seed estimate or generalization across trained models.
uncertainty.method: paired stratified percentile bootstrap and centered standardized maximum bootstrap intervals
uncertainty.standard_error: sample SD of bootstrap means, ddof=1
uncertainty.strata: resample 128 examples with replacement independently within each of the four query-position strata; same indices for every condition, metric and pair
